picks.editorial_note: A nearly $24.5M NIA grant renews UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham's AI center for connected aging/Alzheimer's care for five more years — the week's largest single AI-health funding commitment and a strong academic-medical partnership.
picks.title: UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham Awarded Nearly $24.5M for 5-year Continuation of MassAITC | UMass Amherst

picks.editorial_note: An MIT/CMU/NYU/Stanford team built an AI that beat top human players at Stratego, a game requiring reasoning under hidden information — a genuine algorithmic advance with implications beyond games, achieved via multi-institution collaboration.
picks.title: This game-playing AI is the new champ at Stratego

picks.editorial_note: An AI-enabled biochip from AUC offers rapid, low-cost disease pre-screening for cancers and other conditions, pointing toward real-world diagnostic deployment in resource-limited settings.
picks.title: AI-enabled biochip for rapid cancer, disease detection | The American University in Cairo

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL, with Google and Northeastern, built 'InstructMesh,' letting users repair AI-generated 3D models before fabrication — a practical fix for a known weak point in generative 3D design, backed by industry-academia collaboration.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab scientists developed a machine-learning tool that estimates past radiation exposure from routine blood tests, offering a faster, more accessible alternative to specialized screening with potential public-health applications.
picks.title: A Simple Blood Test Could Reveal Hidden Radiation Exposure

picks.editorial_note: ANU secured $8.1M in Australian Research Council grants to build a critical-materials workforce and advance resource exploration, a notable national investment in AI-adjacent materials science.
picks.title: ANU receives $8.1 million to unlock new materials, critical resources

picks.editorial_note: A Harvard Kennedy School Belfer Center report warns that catastrophic AI risks remain preventable but urgent, citing rogue-agent breaches and OpenAI's training pause — a high-profile policy intervention in the AI-safety debate.
picks.title: Is it already too late to reduce catastrophic AI risk? — Harvard Gazette

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside's $8M in federal Strengthening Institutions grants will fund AI education and workforce-alignment programs, expanding access to AI training at a public research university.
picks.title: UCR receives $8 million in federal grants

picks.editorial_note: Sophia Space and MIT Lincoln Laboratory's new CRADA pairs space-based AI-inference computing with weather-modeling expertise, a notable government-lab/industry partnership with potential climate and defense applications.
picks.title: Sophia Space and MIT Lincoln Laboratory announce research collaboration on space-based weather modeling

picks.editorial_note: SDSU's Advanced Maritime Center launched binational shipbuilding research with Samsung Heavy Industries and South Korea's KEIT, a significant industry-academic-government partnership tied to workforce training.
picks.title: SDSU launches shipbuilding research projects with South Korea, Samsung Heavy Industries | News | SDSU
